metaDescription: Swedish Vallhund vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Swedish Vallhund boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Swedish Vallhund owners tracking 12-15 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where parvovirus risk concentrates for this puppy.
Use the 4-row Swedish Vallhund schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP); 12 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for Swedish Vallhund handling: Viking corgi cousin; eye disease is a known breed topic.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Swedish Vallhund dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Swedish Vallhund core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Swedish Vallhund boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Swedish Vallhund row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Swedish Vallhund item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Swedish Vallhund kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Swedish Vallhund due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Swedish Vallhund core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Swedish Vallhund misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Swedish Vallhund health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Swedish Vallhund adult health guide for breed predispositions such as retinopathy risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
